title: Deepening our collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy
summary: OpenAI and the U.S. Department of Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen collaboration on AI and advanced computing in support of scientific discovery. The agreement builds on ongoing work with national laboratories and helps establish a framework for applying AI to high-impact research across the DOE ecosystem.
body: OpenAI and the U.S. Department of Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen collaboration on AI and advanced computing in support of scientific discovery. The agreement builds on ongoing work with national laboratories and helps establish a framework for applying AI to high-impact research across the DOE ecosystem.
summaryZh: OpenAI与美国能源部（DOE）签署谅解备忘录，旨在深化在AI与先进计算领域的合作，以支持科学发现。双方将利用DOE的国家实验室资源，探索AI在高性能计算及高影响力科研项目中的应用框架。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该合作属于政策与科研协作范畴，未披露具体的模型技术细节或评估数据。
